mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish. Skies are clear with a temperature of 64 degrees at Reddan Soccer Park. We are in the first quarter moon phase this morning.

In city news, you can tune into channel 989 to watch VHAT, which provides public access and government meeting coverage for the Verona area. Additionally, the city is promoting the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop, where you can drop off organic waste for free after registering for a lock.

Today is packed with activities, including the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, trivia at The Bogey Factory, and pizza night at the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the fun continues with a free concert at Century School Park and trivia at Hop Haus Brewing.
Looking at the police report, on July 13, officers responded to a situation where a vehicle was stuck on a rock, leading to the arrest of a 36-year-old man for his first O-W-I offense.
Today's flavor is Mint Explosion. Culver's is currently closed, but they will open their doors at 10:00 AM. If you are looking for tomorrow's treat, it will be the Really Reese's flavor.
